HeirsOfEarth.NationDef.label: Commonwealth of Albion
HeirsOfEarth.NationDef.description: The colony ship Avalon landed on a rainy island rich in coal and iron, and its people did what their ancestors had done: they dug, built and invented. Albion is the only heir nation with steam engines and rifles, ruled by a Lord Protector and a quarrelsome parliament. Its redcoats are disciplined, its merchants ambitious, and it has been at odds with Nova Roma for as long as anyone can remember.

doctrine.label: siege train
doctrine.description: Albion comes with spades and guns. Its armies often dig in and build a battery before they attack, and its riflemen fire steady, measured volleys.
